coverage: A publisher policy revocation scoped to the exact app queued the existing reviewed disable operation for a real managed installation.
The disposable root runner stopped the exact runtime, and Portal recorded a complete stop effect before the test continued.
The revocation retained the data namespace, current access grants, capability grants and runtime identity while denying launch authority.
Restoring publisher trust advanced the revision. Managed enable and repair then reverified the same signed release under current trust and activated a new current tuple.
Owned cleanup removed only fixture resources and preserved the neighbor.
limits: This is a development acceptance on the disposable GitHub Linux root runner. It is not production deployment approval.
Trust is deployment-local; no external trust source is fetched, so an unreachable remote trust source is not simulated.
